## 1. Executive Summary & Value Proposition
Anil Sharma is an accomplished industrial engineering leader with over 28 years of multi-sectoral expertise across continuous process industries, petrochemical complexes, and heavy manufacturing. He oversees plant reliability, electrical infrastructure, automation, and asset integrity for world-scale petrochemical facilities and associated critical utilities.

Beyond plant operations, he is the creator of several global engineering platforms, including **LiveSimulators.com**, **DesignCalculators.co.in**, **ReliabilityTools.co.in**, and **ElectroSafe.homes**—providing free, ad-free, high-precision tools and real-time physics simulators to engineers and students worldwide as a technical community hobby.

### Key Value Pillars
- **Zero-Breakdown Mindset**: Transforming maintenance from an emergency cost center into a strategic profit driver and asset-availability multiplier.
- **Continuous Process Petrochemical Projects**: Steering capital project governance, switchyard modernizations, and asset reliability across world-scale continuous process units.
- **Plant-Wide Power Distribution Automation (220kV to 6.6kV)**: Successfully engineered and commissioned automated electrical distribution and high-speed load shedding systems across 27 substations, securing grid stability and eliminating cascading blackout events.
- **LiveSimulators Ecosystem**: Built 65+ interactive virtual engineering laboratories solving complex first-principles physics directly in the browser with float64 precision.
- **Workforce Facilitation**: SHRM Certified Facilitator, DNV GL Certified IMS Auditor, and Master Technical Trainer who has conducted 2,500+ hours of training, upskilled 200+ graduate engineers and professionals, and won multiple corporate Best Facilitator and Top Trainer awards.

## 2. Professional Chronology & Measurable Achievements

### Continuous Process Petrochemical & Energy Operations (Feb 2008 – Present)
**Position**: Senior Engineering & Reliability Leader – Electrical, Power Systems, Automation & Asset Integrity
- **Project Scope**: Steering multidisciplinary engineering, electrical infrastructure, and asset integrity across continuous process petrochemical facilities.
- **Commissioning Leadership**: Led electrical and instrumentation commissioning for world-scale continuous process units including PTA, PET, GCU (Gas Cracking Unit), and high-reliability utility plants.
- **Substation & Load Shedding Automation**: Engineered and deployed integrated PLC-based electrical distribution and automated load shedding schemes across 27 substations, preventing blackout cascades and securing high-voltage power stability.
- **Inventory & Criticality Optimization**: Optimized spares inventory through equipment criticality matrices (FMEA) and standardized SAP-PM categorization.
- **Technical Capability Building**: Conducted 2,500+ hours of training and workshops on E&I reliability, power systems, electrical safety, and industrial automation.
- **Corporate Accolades**: Recipient of multiple Best Facilitator, Top Trainer, and Safety Leadership awards.

### Multi-Site Automated Infrastructure Operations (Feb 2004 – Jan 2008)
**Position**: Commissioning & Reliability Lead (Engineering Incharge)
- **Multi-Site Project Execution**: Directed end-to-end greenfield engineering commissioning for automated infrastructure networks across northern India.
- **Cross-Disciplinary Command**: Provided unified engineering leadership across Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Civil, and IT automation networks.
- **Hazardous Area Safety**: Designed and delivered specialized hazardous area safety and explosive-atmosphere training with zero reported safety incidents.

### Ambuja Cements Limited (Jul 1995 – Feb 2004)
**Position**: Engineer – Electrical & Instrumentation
- **Greenfield Commissioning**: Key electrical and instrumentation team member during the erection, commissioning, and stabilization of a 2.5 MTPA greenfield cement plant.
- **Energy Optimization**: Spearheaded plant-wide electrical automation and energy conservation initiatives, lowering plant energy consumption by 2.5%.
- **Grid Power Quality**: Automated substation operations and capacitor bank switching, significantly improving power factor and eliminating downtime.

## 3. The 14 Core Corporate Training Disciplines
As a SHRM Certified Facilitator and Master Technical Trainer, Anil Sharma has conducted over 2,500+ hours of training for 200+ graduate engineers and working professionals across:
1. **Electrical Safety & Arc Flash Hazards**: NFPA 70E compliance, IEEE 1584 boundary analysis, shock protection, PPE classification.
2. **Industrial UPS Systems**: Dual-bus 2N/2N+1 topologies, static bypass switching, inverter commutation, harmonic filtering.
3. **Battery Chargers & DC Power Supplies**: Float and boost charging, SCR thyristor control, DC earth leakage detection.
4. **Industrial Batteries & Energy Storage**: VRLA, vented lead-acid, and Ni-Cd battery chemistries, IEEE 485 sizing, impedance testing.
5. **Lockout / Tagout (LOTO) & Safe Isolation**: OSHA / NFPA standard energy isolation protocols, complex key interlocks, verification testing.
6. **Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM)**: SAE JA1011 7-step evaluation, functional failure analysis, task selection algorithms.
7. **Learning from Incidents (LFI)**: Systemic review of electrical and mechanical trip events, institutionalizing preventative barriers.
8. **Root Cause Analysis (RCA) & 5-Whys**: Apollo RCA, cause-and-effect trees, physical/human/latent root causes.
9. **Capital Project Management & Execution**: Greenfield and brownfield plant engineering, commissioning milestones, punch list governance.
10. **Asset Life Cycle & Degradation Modeling**: Bath-tub curve analysis, Weibull wear-out modeling, life cycle costing (LCC).
11. **Obsolescence Management & Modernization**: Switchgear retrofitting, relay migration, legacy PLC/SCADA upgrades without shutdown downtime.
12. **Smart Manufacturing & Industrial IoT**: Digital telemetry, wireless vibration monitoring, smart motor management relays.
13. **Substation & Industrial Automation**: SCADA systems, numerical protection relays (IEC 61850), automated load shedding schemes.
14. **Energy Management Systems (EMS)**: ISO 50001 compliance, power factor correction, variable speed drive efficiency optimization.

## 4. Interactive Virtual Engineering Laboratories (LiveSimulators.com)

### 1. Power Electronics Virtual Lab
- **URL**: https://livesimulators.com/lab/power-electronics-lab
- **Scope**: First-principles browser simulation of switching converter topologies (Buck, Boost, Buck-Boost), SPWM inverter synthesis, Foster thermal networks, and dynamic SiC/IGBT switching loss.
- **Key Formulation**: $V_{out} = \frac{V_{in}}{1 - D} \cdot \eta = \frac{P_{out}}{P_{out} + P_{sw} + P_{cond}}$
- **Standards**: IEC 61800, IEEE 519, JEDEC JESD51.

### 2. Power Systems & Substation Grid Lab
- **URL**: https://livesimulators.com/lab/power-systems-lab
- **Scope**: Dynamic grid modeling reflecting 27 automated industrial substations. Interactive 3-phase symmetrical fault analysis, transformer OC/SC parameter extraction, and frequency-based load shedding.
- **Key Formulation**: $I_{sc} = \frac{V_{LL}}{\sqrt{3} \cdot Z_{th}} \cdot \Delta f = \frac{P_{gen} - P_{load}}{2H \cdot f_0}$
- **Standards**: IEEE 399 (Brown Book), IEC 60909, IEEE 242.

### 3. SafeOps Industrial UPS Simulator
- **URL**: https://livesimulators.com/lab/safeops-ups
- **Scope**: Industrial zero-downtime power simulator. Models dual-bus UPS redundancy (2N/2N+1), static bypass synchronization windows, inverter SCR commutation, and Peukert battery autonomy curves.
- **Key Formulation**: $t = H \cdot \left(\frac{C}{I \cdot H}\right)^k \cdot \text{THD}_v < 3\%$
- **Standards**: IEC 62040-3, IEEE 485, IEEE 1184.

### 4. ElectroLive Electrical Safety & Arc Flash Lab
- **URL**: https://livesimulators.com/lab/electrolive-electrical-safety
- **Scope**: Interactive occupational safety simulator for industrial switchgear. Computes incident energy in cal/cm², defines boundary clearance zones, models earth grid step/touch voltages, and selects PPE categories.
- **Key Formulation**: $E_i = 4.184 \cdot C_f \cdot E_n \cdot \left(\frac{t}{0.2}\right) \cdot \left(\frac{610^x}{D^x}\right)\text{ cal/cm}^2$
- **Standards**: IEEE 1584-2018, NFPA 70E, IEEE 80.

### 5. Turbomachinery & Rotor Dynamics Suite
- **URL**: https://mech.livesimulators.com/
- **Scope**: Rotating equipment dynamics platform. Models Jeffcott rotor whirling, hydrodynamic bearing stiffness/damping coefficients, Campbell frequency diagrams, and dual-plane dynamic field balancing.
- **Key Formulation**: $M \ddot{q} + (C + \Omega G) \dot{q} + K q = F_{\text{unbalance}}(\Omega)$
- **Standards**: API 612 / 617, ISO 10816 / 20816, API 684.
